Teamsters president Sean O'Brien reveals to Tucker Carlson the words Kamala Harris left him with: I will win with or without you. The Teamsters famously declined to endorse a presidential candidate for the first time in decades. O'Brien's blunt hour explains the labor politics behind that break.

O'Brien describes his meetings with Harris and with Trump and how each treated the union. He argues Democrats took working voters for granted while offering little back. Carlson asks what the snub says about the party's future with labor. Working and political viewers get the union man's side of a famous last-words story.
